Did you know almost half of urban India's land is wasted not by accident, but by a rule almost nobody talks about? New York gives 45% of its land to streets and parks; Mumbai gives barely 15%. The difference isn't money, it's a building regulation that forces every structure to sit marooned in empty margins, turning more than half our cities into useless strips of weeds and rubble. In this video, we trace how three policy decisions across 60 years quietly broke Indian cities, why they made housing unaffordable and manufactured the very slums they were meant to prevent, and how places with far less money than us have already solved city infra but we haven’t. 70% of the infrastructure India will need by 2047 hasn't been built yet.
